description: The WHEN OTHER arm of PROCESS-ENTER-KEY's ordered EVALUATE TRUE at :437-442, which is reached only when all three of MONTHLYI, YEARLYI and CUSTOMI satisfy '= SPACES OR LOW-VALUES' - so it also pins the ORDER of the three preceding arms at :213, :239 and :256, since a mis-ordered EVALUATE would have matched one of them. :438 moves 'Select a report type to print report...' into WS-MESSAGE, :440 raises the error flag, :441 asks for the cursor on MONTHLYL and :442 sends. The DISPLAY at :210 is emitted on every ENTER path, including this one. Expected values are STATICALLY DERIVED by reading app/cbl/CORPT00C.cbl, its copybooks, app/bms/CORPT00.bms and app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD - never captured from a COBOL run, which is impossible in this environment (risk R-A). Java has no transient data queue, so EXEC CICS WRITEQ TD QUEUE('JOBS') at :517 is reproduced through an explicit job-submission port; the eighty-byte content is identical and the dataset key JOBS names the TDQUEUE(JOBS) that app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:499-505 defines as RECORDSIZE(80) RECORDFORMAT(FIXED) BLOCKFORMAT(UNBLOCKED) DISPOSITION(MOD).
